name: ai-studio
description: A coding-studio workbench: a project list you can create from a name and a description, and per-project pages with an AI chat column wired to your real Kiro Crew sessions beside a tabbed workspace (seeded requirement, workflow and UI-spec docs, pending diffs, commit history) and a tool sidebar that opens them.
author: qin-zhuopu
highlights: Native chat embedded frameless — real sessions, streaming, tool cards
Three resizable columns with per-pane show/hide that persist
Open docs, diffs, commits, graph nodes and deploy logs as center tabs from the tool sidebar
Lightweight markdown editor with a raw-Markdown toggle
